description: This PHP class 'AttributeBag' provides a structured way to manage a collection of key-value attributes with methods to add, remove, retrieve, and iterate over the attributes. It implements the IteratorAggregate and Countable interfaces for seamless integration with PHP's iteration constructs.

classes.name: AttributeBag
classes.description: A class that manages a collection of named attributes supporting standard collection operations such as get, set, add, remove, and iteration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AttributeBag with an optional array of parameters.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all parameters as an array.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns the keys of the parameters as an array.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces the current parameters with a new array.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Merges new parameters into existing parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, or returns a default if key does not exist.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the value for a specific key.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the parameters.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key and its value from the parameters.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for the parameters.
